$comment: §3.13 (0.5.0). Without an argument: the skill registry — what exists, which tree and tier it sits in, what it costs and how far it can be taken. With a kami index: that kami's unspent points and the skills it has actually taken, with ranks. Skill DESCRIPTIONS and interpreted bonus text are enrich-class, the same rung as item descriptions (§3.12): the decision "do I have points to spend, and where have I spent them" needs neither.

skillsTotal.description: Rows in the skill registry at this pin.

skills.description: The registry, when no kami was named.

kami.description: The kami this answer is about, when one was named.

unspent.description: Unspent skill points — the reference client's "SP" badge.

invested.description: Taken skills with their ranks. Empty when the kami has spent nothing.

type.description: which skill tree the skill belongs to

max.description: how many points can be spent on this one skill

points.description: On an `invested` row: points this kami has actually spent here.

text.description: The pinned client's own rendering of the bonus (parseBonusText), beside the raw facts it was derived from — the §3.12 rule: serve the facts, never invent the formula.
